			local lsw = bit32.band(a, 0xFFFF) + bit32.band(b, 0xFFFF)
			local msw = bit32.rshift(a, 16) + bit32.rshift(b, 16) + bit32.rshift(lsw, 16)
			return bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(msw, 16), bit32.band(lsw, 0xFFFF))
		end

		local function rol(x, n)
			return bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(x, n), bit32.rshift(x, 32 - n))
		end

		local function F(x, y, z)
			return bit32.bor(bit32.band(x, y), bit32.band(bit32.bnot(x), z))
		end
		local function G(x, y, z)
			return bit32.bor(bit32.band(x, z), bit32.band(y, bit32.bnot(z)))
		end
		local function H(x, y, z)
			return bit32.bxor(x, bit32.bxor(y, z))

		local function I(x, y, z)

		end

		function md5.sum(message)
			local a, b, c, d = 0x67452301, 0xefcdab89, 0x98badcfe, 0x10325476

			local message_len = #message
			local padded_message = message .. "\128"
			while #padded_message % 64 ~= 56 do

			for i = 0, 7 do

			end
			padded_message = padded_message .. len_bytes

			for i = 1, #padded_message, 64 do

				local X = {}
				for j = 0, 15 do
					local b1, b2, b3, b4 = chunk:byte(j * 4 + 1, j * 4 + 4)

						shift_index = 4 + (j % 4)
					elseif j < 48 then
						f = H(b, c, d)
						k = (5 + 3 * j) % 16
						shift_index = 8 + (j % 4)
					else
						f = I(b, c, d)
						k = (7 * j) % 16
						shift_index = 12 + (j % 4)
					end

					local temp = add(a, f)
					temp = add(temp, X[k])

					temp = rol(temp, s[shift_index + 1])

					local new_b = add(b, temp)
					a, b, c, d = d, new_b, b, c
				end

				a = add(a, aa)
				b = add(b, bb)
				c = add(c, cc)
				d = add(d, dd)
			end

			local function to_le_hex(n)
				local s = ""
				for i = 0, 3 do
					s = s .. string.char(bit32.band(bit32.rshift(n, i * 8), 0xFF))
				end
				return s
			end

			return to_le_hex(a) .. to_le_hex(b) .. to_le_hex(c) .. to_le_hex(d)
		end
	end

	do
		function hmac.new(key, msg, hash_func)
			if #key > 64 then

			end

			local o_key_pad = ""
			local i_key_pad = ""
			for i = 1, 64 do

scripts.title: ANTI AFK
scripts.features:
🟢 Core Features

1.Anti-AFK System

  🟢 Prevents Roblox’s AFK detection by simulating user input.

  🟢 Two mechanisms:  On idle (triggers when Roblox detects inactivity).

  🟢 Periodic tick (every 240s by default).

2.Lag Watchdog

  🟢  Monitors delay between frames (dt).

  🟢  If delay exceeds threshold (default 0.6s), increments a lag counter.

  🟢  When lag counter exceeds limit:

  🟢  Action = None → does nothing.

  🟢  Action = Respawn → reloads your character.

  🟢  Action = Rejoin → rejoins the game or server-hops.

3.Auto Rejoin on Disconnect

   🟢  Detects Roblox error popup (e.g., Error 277: Lost connection).

    🟢 Attempts to reconnect:

        🟢  First, tries same server instance.

        🟢  If fails, rejoins the place.

4.Server Hop Support

   🟢  Finds a new server with space.

    🟢   Useful to escape laggy/empty servers.

🔸 Manual Controls

1.Manual Respawn

    🟢  Instantly respawns your character.

    🟢  Shows timestamp in three formats: Local, UTC, Bangkok (for reference).

2.Manual Rejoin (Server Hop)

  🟢 Rejoins the game manually.

  🟢 If ServerHop = true, attempts to find a new server.

🔹 UI & Display

1.RightShift Toggle

      🟢  Press RightShift to open/close the menu.

2.Expandable/Collapsible Log 

     🟢   Expandable/Collapsible Log

3.System Stats Display
🟢Real-time:

     🟢  FPS (frames per second).

     🟢  CPU usage (approximate).

     🟢  RAM usage (MB).

     🟢  Ping (ms).

     🟢  Session time (minutes in current server).

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local currentKey = nil

local function setupCharacter(character)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://72722244508749"
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
    local animTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)

    screenGui:ClearAllChildren()

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 100)
    frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.5, -50)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = screenGui
    frame.Active = true
    frame.Draggable = true

    local playBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    playBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
    playBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
    playBtn.Text = "Play Animation"
    playBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 130, 180)
    playBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    playBtn.Parent = frame

    playBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        animTrack:Play()
    end)

    local keybindBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    keybindBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
    keybindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
    keybindBtn.Text = currentKey and ("Set Keybind (Current: " .. tostring(currentKey) .. ")") or "Set Keybind (Current: none)"
    keybindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 50, 150)
    keybindBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    keybindBtn.TextScaled = true
    keybindBtn.Parent = frame

    local waitingForKey = false

    keybindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        keybindBtn.Text = "Press a key..."
        waitingForKey = true
    end)

    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
        if waitingForKey and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
            currentKey = input.KeyCode
            keybindBtn.Text = "Set Keybind (Current: " .. tostring(currentKey) .. ")"
            waitingForKey = false
        elseif currentKey and input.KeyCode == currentKey and not gameProcessed then
            animTrack:Play()
        end
    end)
end

if player.Character then
    setupCharacter(player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    setupCharacter(char)
end)

            addHighlight(player.Character)
        end
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)
    end

    if player ~= LocalPlayer then
